case.summary: Transaction 3602445 for $1,053.79 on card C00750-K2 was flagged solely by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.57. Investigation confirmed that this was an in-person purchase conducted in billing region 315, an established location accounting for 199 prior transactions on the card. The specific cardholder identity has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases, and no testing patterns or suspicious velocity were observed. While the card had a historical association with ring 57671727 via device D000605, that device had zero activity in the 30-day alert window and was not involved in this in-person purchase. The transaction is ruled legitimate, and the case is closed with no fraud.
